components.name: Document file service
components.responsibility: Read UTF-8 file bytes and return errors
components.rationale: Filesystem responsibility can be reused outside IPC

relations.meaning: Candidate Tauri read_file request across the process boundary

claim.explanation: invoke read_file and the Rust command/handler macro provide both sides; the desktop host is outside this fixture
assumptions: Desktop host enables the desktop feature and installs this registered handler; runtime invocation has not been executed.

contract.rationale: utils.ts passes path to invoke(read_file); lib.rs declares command under desktop and registers generate_handler![read_file]
uncertainties: Desktop feature is disabled in the native extraction. No Tauri host runtime or IPC execution was tested.
